wiki.title: Jonah Garson
wiki.extract: Jonah Garson (born 1986 or 1987) is an American attorney and politician serving as a member of the North Carolina Senate representing the 23rd district since April 2026. He was appointed to the role to succeed Graig Meyer, who resigned to become the executive director of the North Carolina Justice Center. Garson previously served as First-Vice Chair of the North Carolina Democratic Party from 2023 until May 2026.
